items: This guide helps you find the responsible public institution or related organization by topic and continue to that organization's own official announcement.
It is not an official government website.
It is not a breaking-news service, news site, or fact-checking service.
It does not rate organizations or sources, or provide AI summaries or decisions.
Listing does not recommend an organization as a whole or guarantee its reliability.
This site does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or currency of destination information. Check the organization's own official announcements directly for current information.
For evacuation and safety decisions during a disaster, follow the latest information from the relevant authorities.
Display order does not represent importance, reliability, accuracy, or recommendation. Destination groups and usage situations do not represent importance or urgency.
The destination site's policies apply after you leave this site.

privacy.input_heading: 2. Input and registration on this site
input_items: The site does not provide an input form.
The site does not provide sign-in or account registration.
The site does not ask you to enter or submit a name, email address, street address, or similar information.
unused_items: The site does not use AI, external APIs, web search, automated collection, RSS, crawling, or scraping.
The site does not use advertising, affiliate marketing, or a separate analytics system.
The site does not use localStorage.
session_items: The site stores only standard or large to keep your selected text size while you move between pages in the same tab.
It does not store organization names, browsing history, URLs, search terms, or personal information.
It does not send the saved value to a server or external service, and does not retain it after the tab is closed.
If the browser's sessionStorage feature (temporary storage that keeps data only while the same tab remains open) is unavailable, the site displays the standard text size.
external_items: Destinations of public institutions and related organizations, the contact page, and the operator profile are external sites.
The destination's privacy policy and other terms apply after leaving this site. This site does not control information collected or stored by an external site.
contact_items: This site does not provide a contact form and instead links to an external portfolio contact page.
The external page's privacy policy applies there.
logs_items: This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. The hosting provider may process technical information required for delivery, such as IP addresses, user agents, and access times.
The operator has not added tracking for advertising purposes.

analytics.heading: 8. Website Analytics
paragraphs: This website uses Google Analytics 4, a service provided by Google LLC, to understand how the website is used and to improve its published information, page structure, guidance to official information sources, and maintenance planning.

Google Analytics 4 uses cookies to collect information such as page views, clicks on links from this website to external websites, access dates and times, approximate geographic location, and browser and device information.

This website does not send names, email addresses, or other information that directly identifies a specific individual to Google Analytics 4. The collected information is not used by the site operator for the purpose of directly identifying individual users.
Information collected through Google Analytics 4 is processed in accordance with the terms and privacy policies established by Google.

This website does not use Google Analytics 4 for advertising, personalized advertising, Google signals, or User-ID. Access to this website's Google Analytics 4 property and reports is granted only to the site operator.
The site operator does not provide analytics data to third parties or use it in a separate analytics system, except for processing by Google that is necessary to provide Google Analytics 4.
The retention period for user-level and event-level data in Google Analytics 4 is set to 14 months.
Users who do not wish to be measured by Google Analytics may disable measurement by using the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on provided by Google.
